About us

About SiteWhiteboard

A whiteboard that opens in one click. No account, nothing to install, and your boards stay with you.

  • Free to use

    Every drawing tool is free. Ads on the site pages pay for it.

  • Private by design

    Boards are saved in your browser. They never go to our servers.

  • Ready in a second

    No sign-up and no download. Open a board and start drawing.

Why we built it

Big design tools are great for big projects. But most of the time you just need to sketch an idea, explain a lesson or draw a quick diagram.

SiteWhiteboard is made for those moments: markers, sticky notes, shapes and arrows on an endless board, on your phone, tablet or computer.
